channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Coffee drinkers show lower fat, more muscle, and hormonal differences
item.description: A Finnish study found that higher coffee consumption is linked to less total and abdominal fat, more muscle, and distinct hormone levels.

item.title: Giant 23-foot crocodylian may have dominated South American food chain
item.description: Fossil bite marks suggest large crocodylians were top predators in Miocene South America, preying on giant prey.

item.title: Ancient Egyptian tomb reveals orderly burial practices over centuries
item.description: Excavations in Theban Necropolis show a structured sequence of burials, reuse, and evolving customs spanning hundreds of years.

item.title: Honeybees adjust feeding to correct nutrient imbalances in pollen
item.description: Honeybees can sense when pollen lacks essential nutrients and modify their intake to avoid potential harm.
